question: Does an independent typed reread of a stratified current raw sample confirm the L500 weapons.json review base?

control.description: M433 velocity of 630 m/s at raw offset 416 reproduced before sample selection and workers.

sampling.algorithm: Python random.Random; sorted family/class strata; sample up to two distinct weapons, one random numeric leaf per weapon; top up each field family to max(ceil(10% of family leaves), its stratum minima). Sparse strata include all available weapons.

sourceFacts.method: Each sampled operand was reread from current 1.4.3.5 raw with frosty-raw-check.py. Earlier reviews supplied explicit field/offset/identity maps, not comparison values. Workers read no site values and produced no verdicts. Parent joined their current operands against the pinned site file. The original field maps and expected bytes/hashes are retained.

classificationRules.match: Exact integer/value equality; a direct site decimal encodes to the same source float32 under the L107 rule; or a documented derived formula equals the site within four float64 ULPs.
classificationRules.precision only: A current operand calculation reproduces an existing L107 retained precision decision; the old detail source value and/or held alias decision is verified against the current calculation. Each row cites L107.
classificationRules.intentional: Only a specific documented in-game deviation or ATTACHMENT_BUGS.md case can justify a value difference. No sampled row required this classification.
classificationRules.mismatch: A source/site difference not covered by the preceding rules; triggers extraction of that family across all 63 weapons.
